status_plain: Readings of PRICE with a recorded Excel build: 8,625 input(s) over 2 recorded environment(s), Excel 16.0 build(s) 20131, 20228, all on Windows; where a CPU is recorded it is an AMD Zen 2. 8,417 input(s) were also read in captures that record no build (some may repeat inputs counted above); they are not counted. 1 same-input comparison(s) between builds over 2 input-pair(s): no result differs. A CPU dependence is expected and untested (see below). No reading from a Mac, Excel for the web, 32-bit Excel or an Intel CPU is recorded.

environments.basis: Recorded by the capture or its run rollup: Excel version and build, CPU. Not recorded: bitness, OS. Platform is Windows because every OxFunc capture drove Excel through COM automation from PowerShell on Windows; the capture does not state the OS. The processor name is that of an AMD Zen 2 part (Ryzen 7 4800H). Workbook Compatibility Version not recorded. Update channel never recorded.
Recorded by the capture or its run rollup: Excel version and build, bitness, OS. Not recorded: CPU. Workbook Compatibility Version 2 as recorded. Update channel never recorded.

comparisons.method: Harvest (tools/efh-environments/harvest.py): Excel answers keyed by function and exact argument bits; every input read in both environments, results compared as typed values (numbers by their binary64 bits). Formula-literal captures excluded.

sensitivities.statement: Handbook evidence record EV-FIN-0022 marks 2 of its counts for this function as CPU-scoped: the counted result depends on how the host CPU executes x87 instructions. Every reading recorded here was taken on an AMD Zen 2 processor or on a host whose CPU was not recorded; no reading on an Intel CPU, a Mac or Excel for the web exists, so a CPU difference is neither observed nor ruled out.
